## Request

View: Ares Capital Corporation's current five-screen Lite handoff is supportable for historical screening-only consumption, subject to its stated source and analytical limitations. This review found no confirmed defect in the scoped Lite consumption, topic allocation, upgrade coverage or priority ordering.
